method: Regenerated fiveSTEP scenes and16step guide; strict material/bounds/reservation, sampled cam/lid/extraction/tool, actual control release and USB installation sweeps; complete finite-wire audit and continuous new tray-joint envelopes.
environment: Windows; Python3.11.3; Node25.9.0; pinned CadQuery2.8.0/OCP7.9.3.1.1/VTK9.6.2/numpy2.4.6/shapely2.1.2; official Windows PrusaSlicer2.9.4; actual Codex in-app Chromium browser.
limitations: No physical print or fit test. Owner printer is unknown; generic220x220x250 PETG/.4nozzle/.2layer profile.
Digital gates do not qualify adhesive, wood condition, creep/fatigue, transport loads, actual servo torque, cables/FPC, hand dexterity or electrical operation.
Cam/material motion is sampled every10degrees; finite-wire checks use0/80/160degrees. Continuous conservative envelopes qualify new tray joints/beams only.
Control removal and USB manual dressing are sampled digital sweeps. Actual soldered leads, terminal bends and retention require physical acceptance.
Linux PrusaSlicer2.9.6 CI and the Git/PR review endpoint remain pending when these local receipts are created.
observation: Digital assembly passed with no unapproved solid/reservation/bounds or finite-wire collision. All6mechanisms pass17angles0..160with adjacent endpoint states. Key receiving/insertion, full nut engagement, accessible11cassette clamps, independent floor anchors/frame and removable contents are checked. Left service now removes three controls, four top screws, plate with its cover nuts, then right ladder with its joint nuts; actual suitcase, bolted left ladder and its nuts remain. USB installation uses both unplugged/uncoiled full plug envelopes through open mouths before forming the coil; no connector is threaded through the small cable duct. 68installed printed copies plus3gauges;29additional screws/29nuts are specified, not claimed purchased.
supersedesReason: The final integrated89-source artifact changed. Actual gates were repeated against its exact digest; earlier evidence and truthful failures remain immutable.
resolution: Corrected clamp/collar/tie/key intersections and actual R8/R20/C1 paths. Final12 extraction failure is resolved by an independently checked accessible release/removal sequence and guide/Inspector regression; no collision threshold or retained-owner exemption was relaxed.

case_geometry.status: Owner measured clear rectangle between rim reinforcements 430x269; wall 5; total rim width including wall 20, front/rear heights 40/30 down from rim; bottom tangents 45/45 modeled as circular arcs; centered full-width brace 80x5. Floor thickness 5, lid partition and hinge axis remain assumptions. Outer 440x309 is derived, replacing the vendor envelope; no shell manufacturing.

limitations: Quasistatic adverse lifting model; no inertia, wear, stick-slip or return-flank qualification
Sliding friction 0/0.2/0.4 and separate 0.5-gravity guide allowance are unmeasured assumptions
Nominal root stress excludes fillets/notches, layer defects, creep, heat and cyclic fatigue
No qualified anisotropic PETG allowable or servo torque curve is available
The 1.5 torque margin is a prototype test target, not acceptance or a guarantee
10 degree sampled BREP motion is not a continuous collision proof
Circular interpolation of measured tangents, floor thickness, lid and hinge axis need dry-fit acceptance
Actual harness bend radius, glue/wood strength, creep, loaded torque and pulse-off untested
Intermediate power loss requires manual support/inspection; no automatic descent
Camera/FPC and horn details provisional; no manufacturing qualification

cassette_usb_insertion.sequence: Tighten bench clamps first; dress both unplugged cable ends through open edges; form coil last

limitations: Purchased-control latch release, actual tool handles and flexible leads need physical qualification

strength.moment_convention: Positive normal=P uplift; physical horizontal heading h; q=P*(nut-centroid)-P*170mm*h. G=sum r*r^T, J=integral r*r^T dA
strength.load_combination: Conservative simultaneous normal P and horizontal P, P=73.575N; full normal reaction applied at each actual nut in turn, not at the key/wood centroid
limitations: Printed/epoxy/wood allowables are explicit design assumptions, not material certification
Nominal roof shear excludes local bending, tunnel notches, print defects and preload
The 45-degree epoxy-key retention cone uses a nominal cylindrical punching screen; radial splitting and cone flexure are unqualified
PETG creep, layer orientation, hot-car exposure and cyclic load remain unmeasured
Key filling, voids, bare wood cohesion, edge peel and adhesion require physical proof
Discrete key moment model assumes elastic sharing; lip bending and redistribution after gaps/creep are unverified
Signed elastic key forces include compression; actual cradle-floor contact has different stiffness and needs validation
Horizontal torsion/shear sharing is not qualified by the normal-traction envelope
Keys avoid relying on PETG chemical adhesion but do not establish wood adhesion
5 kg at 3g with two active supports is an estimate; no crash/drop qualification
